Semantics: exact env=1; ordinary single-card native GEN, spec0/no MTP/no batch/no lookup/no suffix. Host shared_ptr binding lifetime and host mutex only, no device atomics/waits/timestamps. OFF adds no allocation/copy/timestamps. Callback at c4 after existing pool/remote completion records native jobs actual NT and actual route kind; staged/mapped provider separated using plan.pcie_mode. CPU groups=completed jobs; GPU groups=unique actual expert within layer dispatch; entries=actual grouped rows. Logical GU=down_off, Down=bytes-down_off, blob=bytes, once/group. Emitted includes first prefill-sampled token; layer_calls supplies decode dispatch denominator. Overflow saturates and marks incomplete; unsupported NT/layer/provider/count marks invalid. Failed/early scope close labels incomplete status. Normal close after existing ver.wait_commit.

No authoritative queued-copy acknowledgement from fetch hook; queued_h2d_bytes unavailable. PCIe ownership is not physical copy traffic. Extents are logical, not DRAM/H2D. No exclusive timing or bottleneck conclusion. Existing nested timers unchanged. One output block per supported request close, not per-job logging. Scope is decode-only; first prefill token and prefill jobs excluded from route counts.

Main plan: CPU compile/run fixture for provider/NT/cardinality/overflow/math; source/full build; exact env OFF/0/01/1 and unsupported guards/reset/early exits; parity and fault-close checks; bounded 32K real GEN diagnostic only. Stock unchanged upstream bench.sh alone supplies speed comparisons. Main owns all tests and commits. No test pass claimed.
Incomplete: compilation/runtime/parity unverified; hardware traffic/device events/exclusive critical path remain unavailable; no timings for GU/quant/Down added. Require explicit suffix-draft0 because default suffix=3 may otherwise propose lookup windows. Finite aggregate output has no route IDs.
